title: Discordling Spiritcaller
summary: Control the spiritcaller's ferans and their splitting chimeras through repeated spell pressure.
overview: Control the spiritcaller's ferans and their splitting chimeras through repeated spell pressure.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Stagger feran kills so the resulting chimeras remain controllable.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The eligible shaman's Hudar Trittan dialogue summons the spiritcaller and two spiritbound ferans.
Each feran splits into three chimeras when killed.
The spiritcaller cycles Black Symbol of Agony, Deathly Chants and Grip of Mental Reality during combat.
A thirty-minute timer from spawn removes the boss and its associated ferans and chimeras.

notes: Approval E396. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
